Commentary.Commentary: So, England need a mere 173 to win the game and take the lead in this series. This should not be a tough ask for a strong batting line-up like the hosts possess but stranger things have happened. Ireland will need to be at it from ball one and only miracle and wickets can see them win this. Are we going to witness some Irish magic or will England continue steamrolling this game? Join us after the break to find out!

A sorry batting display by Ireland but they have a star in their ranks by the name of Curtis Campher. He was the only light at the end of the tunnel for the tourists and had it not been for the young debutant, they would have barely crossed 100. In his first innings, the youngster showed grit, talent, fight and hunger and got a well deserved fifty. Credit has to be given to Andy McBrine too as he gave support to the youngster and their 66-run stand for the 8th wicket has given the visitors something to bowl at. But a lot of work needs to be done by the batters and their performance with the willow today left a lot to be desired.

An excellent bowling display from the World Champions and the Lions have roared back in their first game at their own den post the showpiece event. The man who made way for Jofra Archer in that World Cup squad, David Willey was the star for the hosts. He started with a bang and killed the Irish ambitions even before their flight could take off. Picking up his maiden 5-wicket haul in ODIs. He was well supported by his pace partner, Saqib Mahmood who scalped 2 was impressive with the new ball. Tom Curran and Adil Rashid got 1 wicket apiece. Willey will take the headlines though as he leads the team to the dressing room.

OUT! CAUGHT! There's the fifer! Willey is all smiles as he gets his first fifer in his ODI career. Another length ball around off, Young clears his front leg and tries to send it into orbit but the ball hits the toe end of the bat and balloons towards mid off. Roy there lunges forward and gobbles it nicely. IRELAND ARE ALL OUT FOR 172!

Uppish again but falls in no man's land. A length ball around off, Young goes after it again. Once again he mistimes it. This time it goes high in the air and manages to clear mid off. Roy chases it down but two taken. The wait for Willey's fifer continues!
Fuller and around off, Young blocks it out.
WIDE! Bouncer down the leg side.

In the air... but it just evades Morgan. A length ball just outside off, Campher looks to hammer it but ends mistiming it towards Morgan at cover. He tries to reach out and catch but it keeps going away from him. In the end, the batters manage to take a single.
Slower short ball around middle, Campher shapes and pulls it down to deep square leg for a single.
Just misses the stumps! Fuller and just outside off, Campher misses his hoick and the ball comes back in too as it goes just past the off pole.
Good length ball angled in. Young tries to block but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls towards third man after hitting the pads and a leg bye is taken.
Two more! Fuller and outside off, Young slices it over extra cover for a couple of runs.
Bouncer around middle, this time it is Young who fails to connect his pull.
FOUR! Useful runs! A fuller ball around off, Young chips it past Mahmood and the ball races to the long off fence. Mahmood tried to catch but it went really quickly.
Another bumper! This one is aimed at the body. Campher once again tries pulling but fails to make any connection.
Swing and a miss! A bouncer outside off, Campher goes for the pull but fails to connect with the ball.
Fuller and around off, Young guides it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball on middle, Young tucks it towards mid-wicket where Moeen Ali does well to field.
Full and on the pads, flicked towards deep square leg for a single.
A shortish ball on the body, Young helps it down to fine leg via a pull to get to the other end.
A single to end the over! Fuller and around off, Young drives it to deep cover and retains strike for the next over.
Good fast and aggressive bowling. Bangs it short around middle. Young ducks under it.
Good length ball around off, it comes in as Young punches it towards point.
Fuller and around off, blocked nicely by Young.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder. A length ball angled in, McCarthy flicks it powerfully. He thinks that he will clear the man but picks out Vince at deep square leg. Second wicket for Mahmood. Last man in for Ireland will be Craig Young. Can he manage to do what McCarthy could not and partner Campher till the end?
Shortish ball around off, McCarthy punches it to point.
Good length ball on the pads, McCarthy looks to flick it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Good length ball this time, McCarthy pushes it back to Willey.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
WIDE! A bouncer but this one is down the leg side. McCarthy looks to pull but fails to connect.
Quick single this time. A good length ball around off, Campher tucks it towards the off side and takes a run.
Fuller and just outside off, McCarthy drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Powerplay 3 time! Final phase of the game meaning now England can have maximum of 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Just a single to end the over! Good length ball on the pads, McCarthy tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
A single now! This wasn't from the middle of the bat though as Campher got an inside edge on this one. The ball rolls towards fine leg.
Ouch! That's on the box! Good length ball around off and middle, Campher looks to push it towards the leg side but misses to get hit on the box.
Fuller and around off, blocked off the back foot.
Good length ball around off, blocked towards mid on.
Shortish ball around off and middle, Campher tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes two. 150 up for Ireland.
On middle, blocked.
Flatter ball around off, this one is forced down to deep point for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Campher comes forward and blocks.
Floated just outside off, McCarthy looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a single.
Floated on middle, this one is blocked.
Shortish ball outside off, Campher goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
Barry McCarthy is the new batsman in. Can he stay at the crease and give helping hand to the debutant Campher?

OUT! CAUGHT! GONE THIS TIME! The aggressive approach has cost McBrine his wicket. A short ball around off and middle, McBrine takes Curran on and goes for the pull but fails to connect. It goes towards deep square leg where Billings lunges forward to take the catch. The partnership is broken and England will be looking to end the innings as soon as they can now.
In the air... but safe. A length ball on middle, McBrine looks to clear long on but mistimes it. However, manages to clear mid on and takes two.
FOUR! Curran goes full and Mcbrine this time drills it through point to get another boundary.
FOUR! Driven nicely! Fullish and outside off, McBrine stays put and drills it through the cover region to get a boundary.
Fuller and around off, driven firmly but straight to mid off.
A fuller ball on the pads, McBrine looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On off, Andy punches it to the off side for a single.
Shorter outside off, McBrine looks to defend but misses.

FIFTY FOR CURTIS CAMPHER! What a debut for him! It has come when his team needed it desperately. Things were looking bleak and Ireland were under the pump and it looked like they would be bowled out for under 100 but Campher has shown a great composure and talent and scored a magnificent fifty on debut. This has given his side some fighting chance. Flighted delivery on off, Campher drives it to cover, the fielder thee misfields allowing Curtis to take a quick single and reach his milestone. He raises his bat as his teammates and support staff stand and applaud the young man's effort and fight.

Doing too much! Shorter on off and middle and spinning in, Campher gets on his back foot and looks to defend but misses. The ball hits him on his pad but high. The English players appeal but the umpire turns it down. Morgan does not review it either.
Flighted on off, McBrine strokes it to cover for a single.
On the pads, Campher flicks it to the leg side for a single.

TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Brings up the 50-run stand between Campher and McBrine! Ireland needed this to get some respectability in the total and these two have done that. Job not done so far, they need to carry on and maybe change gears after a while. Bumper from Tom, McBrine looks to pull but top edges it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Full outside off, Campher drives it towards cover for a single.
On the pads, Andy flicks it to the leg side for a single.
On off, AM blocks it.
Full on off and middle, McBrine defends it.
Length ball on off, Campher pushes it towards cover for a run.
Drinks!
Around 15 overs to go now. What if Ireland do manage to play those out? Can they get to 200? Whether they can defend it or not is another question. It can surely prove to be a morale-booster, right?
SIX! Bang! This one is out of here. Tossed up on off and middle, McBrine heaves it right off the meat and deposits the ball in the empty stand over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Floated on off, McBrine keeps it out.
On the stumps, Andy defends it.
Flighted around off, McBrine sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Short on off, Campher punches it to the off side for one.
England would not want to drag this for too long. Willey needs a wicket to get to his fifer. When will Morgan hand him the ball?
Short around off, McBrine cuts it with spin towards sweeper cover for one.
Another short ball, McBrine pulls it and keeps the strike with a single.
Shortish delivery, Campher pulls it towards deep square leg with ease and gets a single. He looks like a top player, Campher.
Outside off, Campher chops it through point and gets a couple.
Length ball on off, Campher defends it off the back foot.
Good length ball around off, Campher dabs it to short third man.
Length ball outside off, Campher looks to play it on the off side but misses.
Flighted on off, Campher strokes it to cover and keeps the strike.
On the pads, AM flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Floated on off, Andy strokes it to point.
Shorter on off, McBrine defends it off the back foot.
On the pads, Campher flicks it to the leg side and gets a run.
Floated on off, McBrine strokes it towards long off for a run.
Shorter on the body, McBrine pulls it towards square leg and keeps the strike.
Length ball closer to the off pole, Campher looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which goes to third man for a run.
On off, Campher defends it.
Length ball outside off, McBrine punches it through cover and gets a single.
Length ball on off, Andy blocks it off his back foot.
Fuller on off, McBrine defends it off the front foot.
Ireland have managed to reach 100! Can they manage to add another 100? Looks really tough though but you never know.
Short and around off, McBrine goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flatter and around off, Campher pushes it towards point for a single.
Flatter one on the pad, McBrine tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On off, this one is pushed back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle, Campher pushes it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. And with this 100 comes up for Ireland.

Hesitation but safe in the end. Floated on off, Campher defends it towards point and looks for a single. McBrine is a bit hesitant but goes for it. Luckily the throw at the bowler's end is a poor one. That will be the end of Adil Rashid's quota. His figures are 10-3-26-1.
Shorter on off, Campher defends it.
Leg spinner outside off, Campher defends it.
Tossed up on off, Campher defends it off the front foot.
Floated on off, CC defends it.
On the pads, Campher flicks it and finds mid-wicket.
Outside off, played towards the man at point.

Ireland have managed to stabilise the innings but they are still in deep trouble. More than 20 overs to bat and only 3 wickets are in the bag for the Irish. Campher has done extremely well on his ODI debut to stick at the crease after a shaky start. Can England get rid of him soon?

NOT OUT! McBrine had come way too much down the track and this always looked a hopeful one. McBrine looks to come down the track and Ali fires one flatter and on the pads. McBrine misses and England appeal. The umpire does not find too much in it but England take the review eventually. Replays roll in, Ultra Edge makes sure no bat involved. Ball Tracker comes in now and shows that the impact was 3 meters ahead of the stumps and thus it will be umpire's call. Anyway the ball was going over the stumps and it would have been not out.
On off, pushed towards cover for one.
Floated on middle and leg, defended back towards the bowler.
On the pads, McBrine flicks this towards square leg and gets a single.
On off, McBrine plays this one towards the man at point.
A stiff appeal but that looked to be going down. Slower through the air and around the pads, Campher looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
FOUR! Tonked! This will release some pressure. A floated ball on middle, Campehr gets in the position and lofts it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Full toss on middle, driven to long on for a run.
Beaten! Lovely piece of bowling from Rashid.

Confusion but safe in the end. Rashid floats it around off, Campher blocks it towards the leg side and calls for a single. Rashid get to the ball and throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off but McBrine is in.
Full and around off, McBrine pushes it down to long off for a single.
A single to end the over. Shortish and around middle, McBrine goes back and cuts it to deep cover.
Flatter one on middle, this one is pushed towards cover.
Around off, blocked off the front by McBrine.
Fuller and around off, this one is driven to the cover fielder who makes a half stop and a single is taken.
Flatter one around off and middle, Campher forces it towards point.
Shortish and around off, worked towards the leg side.
Loopy full ball around off, McBrine keeps it out.
Shortish and around off, blocked off the back foot.
Beaten! Floated around off and turning away as McBrine tries to defend.
Good shot but only for a single. Full and outside off, Campher drives it well but the mid off fielder does well to make a stop.
Full again, this one is around off, Campher pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and around off, Campher drives it well but finds mid off.
A run to end the over as this fuller ball from Ali is driven down to deep cover.
Short and outside off, McBrine pushes it through point for a single.
A quick single this time. Ali floats this around off, Campher forces it towards point and calls for a single.
Quicker one on the middle, flicked straight to the man at short fine leg.
Shortish and around middle, Campher works it towards mid-wicket.
Floated around off, Campehr blocks it out.
Fuller and around off, this one is pushed towards cover.
Flatter and around off, Campher drives it through point for a single.
BEATEN! Floated outside off, Campher looks to defend but the ball spins away and beats the outside edge.
Floated and extremely full on middle, Campher digs it out.
Flatter this time, Campher defends this towards the off side.
On middle and leg, worked towards the leg side for one.
On the pads, defended towards the man at mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter one on middle and off, pushed towards cover for one.
Floated on off, punched towards cover for one now.
Flatter and on off, defended towards the man at cover. The batters looked for a run but Campher sends his partner back in time.
Flatter one on off, played straight back towards the bowler.
Very full and around off, McBrine pushes it towards the cover fielder. End of a successful over for Rashid and England. 2 wickets and not a single run given.
Andy McBrine walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust and Ireland are falling apart. There was never a run there. Rashid floats this full and just around off, Singh pushes it towards cover and takes off for a single. Campher says no but he has taken off. Banton gets to the ball and throws it to the keeper as Singh tries to get back. However, he has got a lot of ground to make and he falls short as Bairstow collects and whips the bails off.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards the fielder at cover.
Beaten! This is excellent stuff from Rashid. A floated delivery around off, Singh looks to defend but misses as the ball turns away.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Ireland in extreme trouble and it will be Simi Singh who will try and take them out of this miserable state with the bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! O'Brien  is out of here! He was looking good but one would assume he has thrown his wicket away. A loopy ball outside off from Rashid, O'Brien fails to control himself and tries to go inside out but instead mistimes it straight to Willey at long off.
A dot to end the over as this one is pushed back to the bowler.
Floated around off and middle, this one is blocked.
Shortish and around off, O'Brien goes back and punches it for a single through the cover region.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
50-run partnership! A floated ball around off and middle, Campher nudges it towards the leg side for a run.
A shortish one around off and middle to start, O'Brien works it towards fine leg for a single.
Moeen Ali into the attack.
Quicker delivery again, Rashid rocks back and defends this out towards the leg side to get through the over. A maiden over by Rashid.
Floated on middle and leg now, Campher comes forward and blocks it out.
Floated on off, Campher comes forward and defends towards cover.
Another quicker one, Campher looks to go for the sweep but misses.
Flatter on the off pole line, Rashid rocks back  and cuts this towards the man at point.
Flatter outside off, Campher looks to cut but gets an inside edge on it.
Slower one to end the over. This one is around off on a good length. O'Brien does well to keep it out.
Shortish again, this time O'Brien psuhes it to the man at point.
Shortish and outside off, Campher pushes it through point for a run.
Good length ball on middle, O'Brien tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer from Curran and a good one too. However, called wide by the umpire.
Shortish and around off and middle, Campher pulls it down to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish and around middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, O'Brien looks to drive but gets it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off, Campher pushes it between point and cover gently and takes one.
Bowls this one fuller and Kevin pushes it to long off for a single.
Shortish and around off, this one is tapped towards cover.
Floated around off, blocked off the front foot.
Five dots in a row! Excellent over from Curran as he bowls this good length ball around off, Campher stays on the back foot and blocks it towards point.
Another dot! This one lands around middle and leg, Campher pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball around off, this time Campher  pushes it towards point.
Good length ball on middle, Campher works it towards square leg.
Good length ball around off, this one is blocked off the front foot.
On the pads, O'Brien tucks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Cut away nicely! Campher looks like a real talent. Short and wide outside off, Campher cuts it late behind point and gets a boundary as Morgan comes second best in the chase.

Good running! They needed 3 and got it with ease. Shorter outside off, Kevin cuts it through backward point. The fielder from point runs to his left and pulls it before the ropes and saves a run for his side.
Tossed up on middle and off, Campher defends it towards mid off and gets a single.
Floated on middle, Campher defends it.
Leg spinner on middle, O'Brien turns it against the spin towards square leg and gets a single.
Floated on off, O'Brien taps it back to Rashid.
Shortish and  outside off, O'Brien punches it through point for a single. End of the 15th over and Ireland are 60/5.
Fullish and outside off, Campher looks to defend but the ball takes a thick outside edge and goes to third man. A single taken.
Another short one around the hips. O'Brien easily works it towards the leg side for a single.
Shortish and on middle, this one is worked behind square leg for a run.
Appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. A slower one from Curran. Campher looks to defend but misses. They appeal but not out says the umpire. Replays show that there was an inside edge on it.
Shortish and around off, Campher stays on the back foot and pushes it towards point.
Two to end the over! A high full toss outside off, O'Brien drives it wide of David Willey who cuts it off from long off.
Floated around off, pushed towards cover.

FOUR BYES! How did that miss the stumps! A googly from Rashid. This pitches around off and turns in sharply as Kevin looks to block. It sneaks through and goes over the stumps and beats Bairstow as well. It races behind to the fine leg fence.
A couple for O'Brien! A full ball around off, Kevin drives it past the cover fielder and wide of the long off fielder. Two taken. 50 up for Ireland.
Floated on off, blocked off the front foot.
Full and around off, driven towards the cover fielder.
On the pads, Kevin glances it to the leg side and keeps the strike.
Curran once again goes back to bowling on the pads, Curtis flicks it and gets to the other end.
On off, CC defends it.
Fuller on off, Campher follows the boundary with a solid defense.
FOUR! Campher getting in his groove. Shortish from Curran, Campher gets on his back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the pads, Kevin flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
A maiden first up from Rashid as the last ball too has been driven to the cover fielder.
Fuller and just outside off, this time Campher drives it well but finds the fielder at cover.
Down the leg side, Campher looks to tuck it on the leg side but misses. Bairstow pouches the ball and then makes a gentle appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Another one that comes sharply from just outside off. Campher does well to block it off the back foot.
Land outside off and then turns in nicely as Campher shoulders arms. Good turn for Rashid.
A full ball on middle to begin, Campher pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Adil Rashid is on now. Can he inflict further damage on the Irish?
Back of a length ball, angling in, O'Brien hops and defends it towards the off side.
Fuller ball on off, pushed straight towards the man at cover.
On the pads now, O'Brien flicks this one towards square leg for a couple now. Ireland getting some runs now.
Another quick single! Back of a length ball on off, Campher rocks back and defends this towards mid off and snatches a single.
Another one outside off, O'Brien pushes this towards cover now and takes a quick single.
Outside off, played towards the man at backward point.

FOUR! First boundary in ODIs for Campher. A fuller one from Mahmood, Campher leans into the drive and cleanly drives it through the cover. It races away to the fence. End of Powerplay 1 and the scoreboard tells you which way it has gone.
This time it is a length ball outside off and Campher chooses to leave it alone.
Back of a length ball just around off, Campher looks to pull but the ball goes beneath his bat and through to the keeper.
Full ball on off, Campher drives this towards the man at cover.
Outside off, Campher again looks to go after it but the ball whizzes past his bat and Bairstow collects it.
Good length ball on middle and off, defended towards the off side.
On the pads, Curtis nudges this one down to fine leg and takes a single to end the over.
Outside off, Campher looks to go after it but fails to connect.

Superb drive but well fielded as well! Full ball on off, Campher drives it superbly wide of long off. The fielder gives it the chase and does well to keep it into the field as the Ireland batters take a couple. CC gets underway!
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended towards the man at mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Falls in no man's land! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, O'Brien looks to pull but the ball goes off the top edge towards mid-wicket. Luckily for Ireland, no fielder can get to it and a run is taken.
Full outside off, Campher drives but straight to cover.
Length ball on off, Campher defends it towards point and looks for a single but retracts.
Another one outside off, Campher is in no hurry as he knows patience is the need of the hour so he leaves this as well.
Well away from the stumps, Campher shoulders arms to it.
Fullish outside off, O'Brien looks to drive but it goes off the edge towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Kevin defends it.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Campher. This time a double-wicket maiden for Willey and he will be extremely happy with his comeback.
Back of a length on middle and off, Campher gets up on his toes and defends it back towards the bowler.
Campher gets a good length ball around middle and off, defended back towards the bowler. Survives the hat-trick ball with ease.
Curtis Campher is the new man in for Ireland with his team in a lot of trouble. Can he stitch a stand with the experienced Kevin O'Brien?

OUT! LBW! Willey gets another one and he is on a hat-trick now! Lorcan Tucker departs and half the side for Ireland is back in the hut. A good length ball around the leg pole line, it pitches and straightens. Tucker looks to defend  but misses to get hit on the pads. England put in a huge appeal but denied by the umpire. After some waiting England go for the review. Ultra Edge shows no spike. Ball Tracker comes in and THREE REDS, it is pitching inside the line and hitting the leg pole. Ireland lose another one and O'Brien will be really worried at the non-striker's end.

Review time! Straightaway Tucker is the man in question for a LBW. England have taken the review. Replays roll in and nothing on the Ultra Edge. Ball Tracker rolls in, it is inside the line of the leg pole and hitting the leg pole as well!
Lorcan Tucker is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A soft dismissal there and hardly a reaction there from the England players. Willey get another one and this time it is Delany who departs. A wide ball outside off, Delany cuts and cuts hard. Tom Banton at point though goes to his right and takes a very good catch with the ball travelling fast. Ireland lose another wicket and they are in tatters here. They need a strong partnership from somewhere now.
Length ball just around off, defended towards the man at mid off.
Length ball on off, O'Brien blocks it and gets through the over. Good comeback from Saqib. He was expensive in his last over but has bowled a terrific wicket maiden here.
Good length delivery on off, O'Brien defends it.
Kevin O'Brien is the new man in.

OUT! Chopped on! Not the start to his ODI career Tector would have been looking for as he walks out for a duck on his maiden outing! Good length ball just outside off, it is not wide or short enough to cut but Tector goes for the cut. He ends up getting an underedge which unfortunately for him goes onto hit the stumps. He looks at his uprooted off pole in disappointment. Mahmood gets his first of the game and the hosts are all over their neighbors.
Good length ball on off, Tector gets behind the ball and blocks it.
On off, Harry strokes it to point.
Play and a miss! Tector itching to get off the mark in international cricket but his wat continues. Fullish outside off, Tector looks to drive but misses.
Short ball closer to the body, Delany looks to pull but misses. End of the 5th over and Ireland are 28/2.
On the pads, Delany flicks but finds mid-wicket.

FOUR! Through the off side this time! Delany looks to be in the mood! Good length delivery just outside off, nothing much wrong with the delivery but Delany manages to stroke it through point and backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! First time Willey has been treated with anger. Delany comes down the track and takes this length ball on the full and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Delany has no business with it.
Away from the off pole, Delany leaves it alone.
Shorter on off, Delany looks to pull but does not connect well towards mid-wicket. He takes a quick single and keeps the strike. End of an expensive over 13 from it.
Shorter delivery from Mahmood. Delany defends it.
Good length ball on off, Delany takes a back seat and defends it.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundary and the best of the lot! Overpitched on off, Delany gets on his front foot and creams it through covers for a superb boundary.
FOUR! This time a shot of authority! Mahmood overcompensates with a short ball, Delany gets on his back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

EDGED AND FOUR! First boundary off the innings and not a conventional one. Good length ball on off and middle, it shapes away a bit as well. Delany looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which goes past the diving second slip fielder and to the fence.
On off, Tector blocks it. Another superb over by Willey, a maiden-wicket now.
Fuller outside off, Tector looks to drive but unlike his skipper does not edge it but completely misses.
Good ball! Good length ball on middle and off, Tector looks to play it straight but the ball shapes away off the deck and misses the outside edge.
Length ball outside off, Tector leaves it alone.
On off, Tector starts his innings with a solid defense.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! Caught! Willey strikes again and Ireland in big trouble in the third over itself. Full and wide outside off, Balbirnie's eyes lit up and he cannot resist the temptation to drive it. He goes for it and ends up getting a thick outside edge which goes straight to Bairstow behind the stumps. Ireland's two best and experienced batters are back in the pavilion without making much impact.
On the hips now, Balbirnie goes back and pulls this softly towards the man at square leg for a single. Retains strike for the next over does Balbirnie.
Length ball a bit outside off, Balbirnie lets that through to the keeper.
Good length ball angling in towards middle and leg, defended towards the man at mid on.
Good length ball outside off, Balbirnie defends that towards the man at point.
Good length ball outside off, Delany guides it down to third man for a single and gets off the mark.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Delany lets it through for Bairstow to collect.
Mahmood starts with a back of a length ball outside off, Delany leaves it alone.
Saqib Mahmood to start with the second new ball.
The Irish skipper is off the mark! On the pads, Balbirnie flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple to end the over.
Length ball on off, Balbirnie defends it.
Skipper Andy Balbirnie walks out to the middle in the very first over at number 3!

OUT! Caught! Stirling falls right in the trap and the dangerous man is out in the very first over of the game. Early breakthrough for the hosts and Willey strikes. Good length ball on middle and leg, it comes in a bit. Stirling looks to flick but his top hand comes off the handle and he is a bit early in his shot. Hence he ends up hitting it uppishly straight to short mid-wicket who is there for this particular mistake. Eoin Morgan there makes no mistake and takes an easy catch. Terrible start for Ireland as they would have hoped their experienced campaigner to set the platform but he's failed to do that.
Good length ball on off, Stirling defends it off the back foot.

Good length delivery around off, Stirling looks to drive it on th up to the off side but the ball hits the inner half of his bat and the willow turns taking the ball to the leg side and allowing him to get off the mark with a couple.
Willy starts with a fuller delivery on off, Stirling pushes the ball to mid off. Not much movement in the first delivery.

The players are out in the middle. First of all, the bell is rung and the players take a knee in the support of the Black Lives Matter movement. Done and dusted with that! The Irish openers, Paul Stirling and Gareth Delany are out in the middle with the former taking strike. David Willey to start the proceedings for England. Here we go!

Ireland skipper, Andy Balbirnie says they were looking to bat first anyway as the pitch looks great and he has no problem in doing so. Tells that the facilities here have been outstanding and the preparation has been excellent for them.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that the pitch looks good and credits the ground staff and everyone involved. Tells the preparations have been excellent. Says that the guys have had a lot of opportunities given to them and tells there won't be too much chopping and changing.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Gareth Delany, Andrew Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector (DEBUT), Kevin O'Brien, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Curtis Campher (DEBUT), Simi Singh, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy, Craig Young.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow (WK), James Vince, Eoin Morgan (C), Tom Banton, Sam Billings, Moeen Ali, David Willey, Adil Rashid, Tom Curran, Saqib Mahmood.

TOSS - It's time for the flip of coin. After a long time we have Eoin Morgan out for the toss for England. He is joined by Ireland skipper, Andy Balbirnie. Up goes the coin and it comes down in the favour of the hosts. ENGLAND OPT TO BOWL!

It is time for ODIs to make a comeback amid the COVID-19 times as England and Ireland get ready to face off in a 3-match series. England are playing at home for the first time post their World Cup win last year. While there are no spectators in the stadium, plenty of eyes will be glued to the TV screen all over the world as the shorter format of the game gets underway. England have made a few changes to their regular team by dropping names like Root, Archer, Stokes and Buttler which gives them to test their bench. Ireland, on the other hand, will be eager to start the tour with a win. Stay with us for the Toss and team updates.
